meta.description: Landmarks drawn as an optional map layer. Points with source 'stop' are placed at the published position of a bus stop whose name says what it is; they mark a place near the landmark, not its outline. Points and shapes with source 'osm' are real features from OpenStreetMap: rivers, canals and named lake outlines (clipped to the map window), the footprints of station buildings, and named stations and places.
sources: OpenStreetMap station and station-building export (HOT raw-data-api)
Reviewed stop names and positions in kolkata-bus-data.json
